resolution.note: krn verify prints biome error headers for changed paths and the fix command

title: krn verify names the lint error for changed paths
body: Outcome: when krn verify lint fails, it prints each biome error (not warning) diagnostic header for the changed paths, plus the fix command `npx biome check --write <paths>`, so the lead does not open lint.log. Evidence: #199 (noControlCharactersInRegex) and #200 (formatter diff in test/rules/invisible-format-source.test.ts) each had a first krn verify FAIL on lint; lint.log holds ~100 repository-wide warnings, so finding the one error took two extra greps. Proof: new observer red at base by assertion.
